source_note: Primary sources are official Orange County Notices of Commencement and other public records. News articles are secondary references only.

permits.title: Magic Kingdom – 1610 Magic Kingdom Dr (near Haunted Mansion / Piston Peak) – Walt Disney Imagineering / PCL
permits.description: Notice of Commencement filed by Walt Disney Imagineering for “General Construction” at 1610 Magic Kingdom Drive, Bay Lake, FL 32830 — a new/unlisted address adjacent to Haunted Mansion (1600 Magic Kingdom Dr). Contractor: PCL Construction Services Inc. Expiration defaults to one year. Likely related to new structure (possibly restroom or support building) visible on Piston Peak National Park models and aerials. Official Orange County document referenced by multiple sources.
permits.location: Magic Kingdom – near Haunted Mansion / Piston Peak construction site

permits.title: Disney’s Hollywood Studios – Harryhausen’s (Monstropolis) – Walt Disney Imagineering / PCL
permits.description: Notice of Commencement filed by Walt Disney Imagineering for “General Construction” at 359 Cypress Drive (Harryhausen’s, formerly Mama Melrose’s Ristorante Italiano) as part of Monstropolis transformation. Contractor: PCL Construction. Part of ongoing restaurant conversion including facade and interior show elements. Official Orange County document linked by source.

permits.title: Disney’s Hollywood Studios – Archie’s Scare Pig Pizza (Monstropolis) – Walt Disney Imagineering / PCL
permits.description: Notice of Commencement filed by Walt Disney Imagineering for “General Construction” at 357 Cypress Drive (Archie’s Scare Pig Pizza, formerly PizzeRizzo) as part of Monstropolis. Contractor: PCL Construction. Supports restaurant conversion with new recipes and equipment. Official Orange County document linked by source.
permits.location: Disney’s Hollywood Studios – Monstropolis – Archie’s Scare Pig Pizza

permits.title: Magic Kingdom – Adventureland (near Jungle Cruise / 4851 Caribbean Way) – Facilities Asset Management / MLC Theming
permits.description: Notice of Commencement filed September 21, 2026, by Facilities Asset Management for “General Construction” at 4851 Caribbean Way (popcorn cart area near Jungle Cruise entrance in Adventureland). Contractor: MLC Theming, Inc. Notable multi-year expiration of August 31, 2028 (longer than standard one-year default). No specific project announced. Official Orange County document referenced by sources.
permits.location: Magic Kingdom – Adventureland – near Jungle Cruise

permits.title: EPCOT – Norway Pavilion (1600 Avenue of the Stars) – Buena Vista Construction
permits.description: Notice of Commencement recorded September 21, 2026, with Orange County for construction and electrical work at 1600 Avenue of the Stars (main Norway Pavilion building housing Frozen Ever After, Akershus, The Fjording, etc.). Description: “Provide labor, material and/or electrical for construction.” Contractor: Buena Vista Construction Company. Standard one-year term. No specific attraction or guest-facing change identified. Official Orange County document referenced by source.

permits.title: Disney Springs – UNIQLO (Buena Vista Construction / Facilities Asset Management)
permits.description: Notice of Commencement filed September 22, 2026, by Facilities Asset Management (FAM) with contractor Buena Vista Construction Company for “General Construction” at UNIQLO (Town Center). Expires September 21, 2027. Part of a group of FAM/BVCC general construction filings at Disney Springs restaurants and retail locations the same day. FAM/BVCC typically indicate maintenance or infrastructure work. No specific project announced. Official Orange County document referenced by sources. Source: Inside the Magic; WDWNT.
permits.source_name: Inside the Magic; corroborated by WDWNT
